brief_summary: Reskin an existing modular retail kiosk in a new brand identity and deliver dimensioned front/rear elevation specs plus one photorealistic in-location composite for the landlord submission. Structure is fixed; only colour, finish and branding change.

models.why: cheapest way to prove orthographic holds
same engine keeps identity across the composite

stages.name: Front elevation (ANCHOR)
stages.gate: HUMAN — pick 1; it becomes the identity reference for every later stage

stages.name: Rear elevation (derived)
verify: front signage not duplicated on the back

stages.name: In-location composite
verify: perspective matches the atrium's vanishing lines
stages.gate: HUMAN — landlord-facing, confirm placement before overlays

stages.name: Dimensions + change callouts
verify: every dimension matches the measured spec
no text was typed by an image model
callout leaders land on the right features

optimizations: One cheap 2k validation render before any batch — proves the orthographic constraint holds
Independent renders launched as background processes and polled, never serialized with --wait
Derive, don't regenerate: the stage-2 anchor feeds every downstream stage as image-1 identity
One change per re-roll on a FAIL, capped at 2 retries per stage
All dimensions and labels composited with overlay.py — 0 credits, no misspellings
2k everywhere except the single 4k hero composite

findings.rule: Australian Consumer Law s18 and s29(1)(g) — misleading representations about the standard or quality of goods
findings.why: A superlative that names a measurable attribute against every competitor in the country. It is rendered into the signage by the image model, so it ships on the landlord submission and on the built kiosk. The client holds no substantiation.
findings.fix: Roasted weekly in [suburb]. Specific, verifiable, and stronger as copy.

findings.rule: ACL s18 — conduct likely to mislead, read with the centre's tenancy lease
findings.why: Trading hours in an enclosed centre are set by the lease, not by the tenant. Rendering this into permanent signage commits the operator to hours they may not control, in a document going to the landlord for approval.
findings.fix: Confirm permitted trading hours against the lease before this is rendered. Omit from the submission if unresolved.

findings.rule: Internal drawing standard — dimensions carry units
findings.why: An unlabelled dimension on a landlord-facing elevation is read as whatever the reader assumes. Free to fix in the overlay config.

unverified.question: Does the centre's tenancy design guide cap fascia text height or restrict signage typefaces?
unverified.settled_by: The centre's tenancy design guidelines, from the landlord's leasing contact. Decides whether the fascia copy fits at all before it is rendered.

unverified.question: Permitted trading hours under the lease

disagreements.issue: Whether "Australia's freshest coffee" is actionable or mere puffery
disagreements.call: Actionable. Puffery survives where no reasonable consumer would read a claim as factual, and freshness is a measurable attribute with a comparative superlative attached. Kept at high, not dropped.
